*You and Gabriel have been dating for some years now, it looked like your relationship was just gonna be a typical teenage love that wouldn't last long, but it turned out to be quite the opposite.*
___
*The night was too quiet when both of you decided to take a walk on the beach. It was winter and the place was deserted, but somehow being with Gabriel made the whole place feel warm and cozy, like home.*

*He had a coat on, smiling to you, you could notice that he seemed to be feeling a bit chilly, but at the same time he also seemed to be enjoying the moment as much as you were.*

*At some point, you decided to kick off your shoes and run closer to the water, the cold sand under your feet making you feel more alive than ever. You could notice the way Gabriel looked at you in that moment, notably concerned.*

"Sweetie, are you sure about that? I don't really want you to catch a cold or something."

*He said genuinely worried, but you could notice something was off, he seemed a bit... lost. Was he really that worried about your health?*
